tools.name: npi_lookup
tools.description: FREE. Look up a US healthcare provider by NPI number or name (+ state): specialty, status, practice address — top 3.

tools.name: provider_search
tools.description: PRO. Providers by specialty (taxonomy text, e.g. 'Dentist', 'Physical Therapist') + city/state/ZIP — up to 200, for recruiting, sales and referral networks.

tools.name: batch_verify
tools.description: PRO. Verify up to 50 NPIs: active status, name, specialty, address — for credentialing, billing and payer onboarding.
